sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Multi-Channel Omni-Helpdesk and Conversational Bot Cloud

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law corporate framework modeled on Delaware and New York statutes, combined with customary law principles and Compact of Free Association federal-law influences)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (Title II trade and investment provisions)
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)
No bilateral investment treaty or comprehensive double taxation agreement currently in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2019, as amended, together with the AML/CFT Regulations 2019; beneficial-ownership and customer-due-diligence directives and guidance issued by the Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar of Corporations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certificate of Incumbency / Good Standing for each proposed director, officer, and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the individual's or entity's jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized corporate charter and certified resolutions of the parent entity (if incorporations as a subsidiary)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry or notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy of each beneficial owner accompanied by an apostilled identity affidavit
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary public in the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or verifiable proof of funds for the future corporate bank account

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, the OFAC SDN list, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UK HMT sanctions list, and any domestic RMI designation list maintained by the Financial Intelligence Unit. Politically Exposed Persons are subject to enhanced due diligence requiring a second independent source of wealth verification and senior management approval, consistent with the AML/CFT Act 2019 and Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering supervisory expectations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations – RMI Corporate Registry (name availability search and reservation conducted exclusively through licensed RMI registered agents; online registry portal administered under the delegated registry operator framework)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in English or Latin-script characters, must be distinguishable from all existing and reserved names in the register, and must end with a statutory corporate designator: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Company', or their accepted abbreviations 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Ltd.', or 'Co.'. Non-Latin scripts, diacritical marks, and symbols are not accepted for registry entry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the notice of refusal, stating the grounds of distinctiveness and exhibiting any supporting legal argument or trademark evidence. The Registrar shall issue a written determination within 10 business days of receipt. A further appeal lies to the High Court of the Marshall Islands by way of judicial review. Name reservations may be renewed for successive 30-day windows upon payment of the statutory renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted - a non-resident Business Corporation engaged in low-risk helpdesk and conversational-bot SaaS services is not required to maintain operational premises in the Marshall Islands; the registered office address of the licensed RMI registered agent in Majuro satisfies the statutory registered-office obligation, provided that a physical registered address, designated agent acceptance, and valid service-of-process arrangements are maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - annual likelihood of unannounced physical on-site inspection estimated below 5% for a non-resident, tax-exempt, low-risk entity with no local business activity or adverse AML/CFT risk indicators.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and name reservation fee (first 30-day reservation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (collected through licensed registered agent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation filing and registration fee (minimum authorized capital bracket)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office - first annual fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of licensed agents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO profiling, AML/CFT customer due diligence, and PEP/sanctions screening per beneficial owner
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent AML compliance officer / reporting entity supervised by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory customer due diligence obligation under AML/CFT Act 2019; market compliance benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille of identity and corporate documents (bundle of four documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and RMI Designated Competent Authority under the Hague Apostille Convention

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence memorandum and incorporation instructions (outside counsel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for corporate counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent courier, file-opening, and administrative handling charge

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as amended and codified in Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, including the provisions governing Articles of Incorporation, registered office, registered agent, directors, officers, and corporate records.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar, Republic of the Marshall Islands Business Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. The Business Corporations Act does not impose a minimum paid-up capital requirement and no escrow deposit is required. Shares may be issued with or without par value, and consideration may be determined by the board of directors unless otherwise stated in the subscription terms.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the share subscriptions shown in the subscriber register and the lawful consideration received therefor, and authorizes the issuance of the subscribed shares. RESOLVED, that the registered office address stated in the Articles of Incorporation, Republic of the Marshall Islands, is adopted as the Corporation's statutory registered office, and the registered agent appointed in the Articles is approved to accept process and official communications. RESOLVED, that [Name] be and hereby is appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, with authority to execute filings, banking instructions, and commercial agreements necessary to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar, Republic of the Marshall Islands Business Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance application through the Business Registry or a licensed registered agent. The proposed name must be distinguishable from existing corporate names and must include a corporate identifier such as Business Corporation or Corp. A preferred name may be reserved for a standard reservation period before filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, file an alternative name or request administrative review with the Registrar. Amended name documents must be submitted before the formation filing deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft, Execute, and Notarize Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporators, notary public, and reviewing registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare Articles of Incorporation in English containing the corporate name, initial registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, registered agent, authorized share structure, permitted purpose covering ISIC 6201 helpdesk SaaS activities, and incorporator details. Execute the Articles before a notary public. If executed outside the Marshall Islands, the notarization must be authenticated by the appropriate apostille or consular legalization procedure.
required_dossiers: Incorporator passport or government-issued identification copy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any defective provisions and re-execute the Articles before a notary. Submit the cured version for review and refile with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing with the Registrar and Payment of Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar, Republic of the Marshall Islands Business Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation with the Business Registry and pay the official state filing fee of USD 250 by bank wire or registered agent mechanism. The Registrar examines compliance with the Business Corporations Act and issues a Certificate of Incorporation upon approval. The effective date may be the date of approval or a later date stated in the Articles.
required_dossiers: Transmittal letter addressed to the Registrar
Evidence of government filing fee payment
Registered agent consent if not incorporated in the Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any Registrar query by supplying corrected or supplementary information. If the filing is rejected, cure the defect and resubmit with the Registrar's reference number within the stated response period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Registered Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar and licensed Marshall Islands registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the statutory registered office address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the appointment of the registered agent. The registered agent must accept service of process and official communications. The Registrar may issue a confirmation or the registered agent may provide a certificate of acceptance evidencing the arrangement.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent and physical office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent withdraws consent or resigns, appoint a successor agent by board resolution and file the necessary Articles of Change with the Registrar without delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board of Directors Organizational Resolution and Share Ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Business Corporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or act by unanimous written consent in accordance with the Business Corporations Act. Adopt the first board resolution accepting subscriptions, approving the registered office and registered agent, and appointing officers. Issue share certificates and open the statutory share ledger and corporate record book.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution or unanimous written consent
Share subscription records and contribution evidence
Registered office and registered agent acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural omission may be ratified by a subsequent board resolution. Amend corporate records and, if necessary, file a curative statement with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Kit, Share Ledger, and Post-Filing Compliance Calendar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Compile the corporate records binder, share certificates, stock ledger, bylaws, and annual report or registered agent renewal calendar. Preserve the non-resident tax-exempt status by maintaining no local-source activity beyond permitted foreign business operations and by complying with any annual report and registered agent renewal deadlines.
required_dossiers: Share ledger and issued share certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an annual report is late or the non-resident status is questioned, file the delayed report with the applicable penalty and provide a board certification confirming absence of local-source business activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None applicable to ISIC 6201 cloud helpdesk software activity; a local building authority may apply only to standard office occupancy.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no industrial, manufacturing, or physical operational permit is required for the Multi-Channel Omni-Helpdesk and Conversational Bot Cloud business under the target scope.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / No EIA required for Class III office and cloud software activity with no stationary emission source or industrial discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or combustion emissions are generated by the SaaS helpdesk platform. General office waste must be managed under municipal collection rules. If the company later installs physical data center equipment or any regulated emission source, a supplemental EPA registration or environmental impact assessment may become applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No civil defense license is required for a non-manufacturing helpdesk or software-as-a-service office. The lessee must maintain fire extinguishers, exit signage, electrical safety, and structural load compliance as required by the applicable building code and the landlord's occupancy certificate. No specialized occupational clearance is required for purely remote customer-support operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Office, Ministry of Finance of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) — public portal: RMI Government eServices and ASYCUDA World customs clearance portal; corporate registry: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Justice, Licensing and Foreign Affairs (https://www.rmioc.gov/).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity incorporates a Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990 by submitting Articles of Incorporation, a Registered Agent Certificate, and the registration fee to the Registrar of Corporations. No income-tax TIN or VAT ID is issued because the non-resident business corporation is statutory tax-exempt. The entity receives a Certificate of Incorporation and, upon annual fee payment (USD 500), a Certificate of Good Standing. If the entity employs local staff, it must register with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration (MISSA) for an employer social security number and with the Revenue and Taxation Office for the 2% wage tax, obtaining an employer account reference that serves as the functional tax ID for payroll remittance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists because the RMI has no income tax statute. The Business Corporations Act provides an elective status distinction: filing a certificate designating the corporation as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (conducting no business within the RMI) secures exemption from all RMI taxes; conversely, a resident corporation may elect to conduct local business, thereby becoming subject to the 2% wage tax, import duties, and the annual fee regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT/GST). Indirect taxation is limited to customs import duty under the RMI Customs Act and selective commodity taxes on fuel, tobacco, alcohol, and diesel; services exports are outside the scope of any Marshall Islands indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — the RMI imposes no turnover-based indirect tax and therefore sets no registration threshold. For customs duty, an importer fiscal number is activated upon the first import declaration in ASYCUDA World; for the 2% payroll wage tax, the employer becomes liable from the first RMI-resident employee.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping mandate applies. Customs clearance is performed through ASYCUDA World electronic export/import declarations. Annual government fees (USD 500) and wage tax remittances are processed through licensed resident agents and the Revenue and Taxation Office respectively; payment does not require fiscal clearance certification.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The RMI does not impose VAT or GST, so there is no zero-rated export regime to claim. Multi-channel omni-helpdesk SaaS delivered by a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation to foreign customers is entirely outside the scope of RMI tax; no Marshall Islands-source income or taxable supply arises, and no refund mechanism is required. Goods exported from a Tax Exempt Zone or freeport operation qualify for duty suspension subject to an export declaration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ASYCUDA World Electronic Export Declaration / Customs Export Entry (where goods movement is claimed as duty-suspension or re-export)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from the RMI
Commercial invoice and underlying SaaS service contract (Stripe Billing/PayPal settlement records) evidencing offshore service delivery
Bank MT103/SWIFT inward remittance confirmation — note: no statutory 180-day FX repatriation rule applies in the RMI (neutral exchange-control regime)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating fraud regime exists. Misuse of duty suspension or exempt status is sanctioned under the RMI Customs Act and Business Corporations Act: fines of up to treble the duty evaded, forfeiture of goods, revocation of the annual certificate, and administrative dissolution for non-payment of the USD 500 annual fee or absence of a licensed resident agent; in dissolution, directors may be held personally liable. Misrepresentation on the non-resident certificate taints the corporation's limited-liability shield retroactively.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No indigenous central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The United States dollar is the sole legal tender, and monetary-base control is effectively delegated to the United States Federal Reserve System. Domestic banking supervision is exercised by the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, under the Banking Act 1987 (as amended); AML/CFT supervision is coordinated with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit. De facto central-bank functions (currency issuance, lender of last resort, payments settlement) are supplied by the US banking system, primarily through Fedwire and CHIPS correspondents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility applies. The RMI imposes no exchange-control law, no foreign-exchange licensing, no dual-currency regime, and no capital-account restrictions. Current account flows (SaaS subscription fees, vendor invoices) and capital account flows (shareholder capital injections, profit repatriation, dissolution distributions) are equally permitted without FIU or ministerial approval. Because USD is domestic legal tender, there are no currency conversion hurdles; non-USD accounts (EUR, GBP, AUD, NZD) may be held at licensed banks but settlement remains USD-centric. No withholding tax or remittance tax is levied on dividends, interest, or liquidation proceeds of a non-resident Business Corporation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. As USD is the domestic currency, export proceeds from ISIC 6201 customer-support Helpdesk SaaS services are received directly in USD and are not subject to any surrender ratio, repatriation deadline, conversion certificate, or proceeds-tracking requirement. Income derived from sources outside the RMI by a non-resident domestic Business Corporation is outside the RMI income tax base, and no treasury filing accompanies cross-border receipts.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility. Global fintech EMIs (e.g., Wise Business, Payoneer) typically do not support RMI-incorporated entities for standard onboarding; Stripe does not list the Marshall Islands as a merchant-supported country, and PayPal merchant / Billing-API services are unavailable in the RMI (consumer send/receive personal accounts are not a compliant commercial rail). Legally, any foreign EMI taking deposits from RMI persons or holding itself out as a bank in the RMI would require a license under the Banking Act 1987; no offshore EMI holds such a license, so offshore EMI usage is an extraterritorial practical workaround rather than a regulated local service. The recommended compliant structure is a US, Singapore, or Hong Kong processing entity under identical beneficial ownership, contracting back-to-back with the RMI BC under an intercompany SaaS agreement, with funds settled exclusively via MT103/Fedwire rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: BMI requires a physical appearance of directors and beneficial owners at its Majuro headquarters, or a notarized identity verification executed before an RMI consular officer or a licensed RMI attorney; purely remote video KYC is not accepted. Bank of Guam may permit remote electronic KYC for low-risk corporate clients through its regional digital onboarding, subject to enhanced due diligence and a registered-agent corporate reference. A recorded video interview is nevertheless recommended as best practice for directors located offshore, together with certified passport copies and a bank-to-bank reference, to pre-empt correspondent-bank de-risking.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction-risk stigma arising from offshore corporate formation in a Pacific jurisdiction historically subject to FATF increased monitoring and EU non-cooperative listing cycles.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing; registered-agent certificate; RMI tax-exemption certificate; audited or reviewed financial statements; substance narrative describing Helpdesk SaaS operations; executed customer contracts; and confirmation that the entity and all UBOs are absent from sanctions and watchlists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverified or anonymously held beneficial ownership, including perceived bearer-share or nominee-share exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete registered share ledger; certified passport copies of all UBOs; Beneficial Ownership Declaration filed with the RMI registered agent under the RMI beneficial-ownership transparency regime; nominee declaration and underlying trust deed, if applicable; and source-of-wealth statements for each UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero minimum capital and ostensible lack of economic substance or commercial bona fides.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT MT103 credit advice evidencing paid-in share capital; serviced-office or registered-agent lease in Majuro; director and employee CVs; active bank statements showing operating revenue and expenses; payroll and vendor invoices demonstrating arm's-length substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment-rail mismatch triggered by inability of Stripe and PayPal to onboard an RMI legal entity directly, creating a suspicion of layering through intermediary processors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Intercompany Software-as-a-Service and payment-processing agreements with the US/SG/HK payfac entity; transfer-pricing documentation; merchant underwriting pack; customer order trail from invoice to settlement; and a confirming legal memorandum that no RMI banking or payment license is required for such a pass-through processing structure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound protocol: shareholder funds are remitted via SWIFT MT103 to the MH_BC USD account at Bank of Guam (US correspondent routing via the Federal Reserve/CHIPS) or BMI, with the payment narrative reading 'Share capital subscription - MH_BC'; no RMI exchange-control or FIU preclearance is required, but the receiving bank may demand a board resolution authorizing the capital increase, an updated share register, and UBO source-of-funds statements. SaaS subscription collections from Stripe/PayPal are routed through the intermediary processing entity and settled as ACH/Fedwire USD credits to the MH_BC account with the narration 'Service fees under Helpdesk SaaS agreement'; availability is typically one to two business days.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail for trade settlements is SWIFT MT103 for vendor, subcontractor, and intercompany payments; SWIFT MT202/COV is used for correspondent-bank treasury transfers; Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700/MT707) are technically available through BMI or Bank of Guam but are unnecessary and commercially inappropriate for ISIC 6201 Helpdesk SaaS disbursements. Card-acquirer settlements from Visa and Mastercard networks arrive via the payfac entity as USD ACH or Fedwire credits. The RMI has no domestic RTGS or ISO 20022 instant settlement system, so outbound scheduling must observe US Fedwire/CHIPS cut-off times and clearing calendars.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla FX forwards (USD vs EUR, GBP, AUD, NZD) executed with top-tier offshore counterparties under ISDA documentation; no RMI licensing restriction applies
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referenced to USD fixings for currencies without offshore deliverability
Cross-currency swaps and FX rollovers aligning long-term subscription receivables with SaaS infrastructure and payroll liabilities
FX call/put options used as hedges on forecast multi-currency customer collections; spot conversion within the multi-currency Bank of Guam account is also permitted without restriction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report and Franchise Tax Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 of each calendar year; a 60-day grace period through June 30 may be available before additional sanctions are assessed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge on unpaid franchise tax after April 30; additional 10% surcharge after June 30; continued non-filing may trigger a notice of dissolution and administrative strike-off by the Registrar of Corporations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (required to maintain records under Marshall Islands anti-money laundering and beneficial ownership regulations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the corporation's registration anniversary, or within 30 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government fee; failure to comply with beneficial ownership record-keeping requirements may result in registered agent resignation, monetary penalties under AML regulations, and potential administrative dissolution for persistent non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation; voluntary audit may be required by shareholder resolution or if financial statements are submitted to a secured lender or used for credit or regulatory purposes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or US GAAP, as consistently adopted by the corporation; Marshall Islands non-resident exempt companies are not required to file financial statements with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The corporation must provide to its registered agent an annual written confirmation identifying each beneficial owner holding 10% or more; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be reported within 30 days, and the registered agent is required to maintain an updated Beneficial Ownership Register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shares and Share Transfers

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $5,000 - $10,000 (voluntary audit only; no statutory audit mandate)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a non-resident domestic Business Corporation. The Income Tax Act 1989 (RMI) taxes only gross income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; a non-resident domestic corporation is statutorily exempt on all foreign-source income. The nominal 11% gross income tax on RMI-source revenue is inapplicable to the offshore Helpdesk SaaS model.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 100% territorial exemption for foreign-source income; zero capital gains tax; zero dividend, interest, royalty, and branch-remittance withholding taxes; zero gross revenue tax and zero business license tax for a non-resident BC transacting no business within the RMI; no net-worth or capital tax. The only mandatory annual charges are the US$50 annual report filing fee and a minimum US$200 annual franchise fee (scaled by authorized share count).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Report of a Business Corporation (Business Corporations Act 1990, Part V) — filed electronically by the RMI-licensed registered agent through the RMI Registrar of Corporations online filing portal (https://www.register-iri.com) or the licensed agent's proprietary e-filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — once per calendar year on each anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary date of incorporation; the report must be delivered on or before the last day of the month in which the anniversary falls.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporation name, company file number, and jurisdiction of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact legal name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation. Any operating trade name (e.g., the SaaS brand used on Stripe/PayPal) must be declared as a business alias.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office and registered agent in the Marshall Islands: physical address (c/o agent) maintained in Majuro and the name/address of the RMI-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical local office is not required; the registered agent's address satisfies the statutory requirement. The agent is the official service-of-process point and is obligated to hold beneficial-ownership records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: names, residential addresses, and nationality of each director and officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors and officers may be non-residents of any nationality; no RMI residency requirement exists. Stripe/PayPal and any RMI corporate bank will independently require KYC identification of the ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital: number of authorized shares, par value, issued shares, and consideration received.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement. The annual franchise fee tier (US$200 minimum) is computed from the authorized share count; nominal issuance (e.g., 1,000 shares) is standard for a non-resident BC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident domestic corporation declaration: confirmation that the corporation conducts no business in the RMI, derives no RMI-source gross income, and is owned/controlled by non-residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete and sign this declaration; it is the operative document supporting the 0% tax exemption. A false certification converts the exemption into a tax-evasion liability and exposes the signatory to criminal penalties under the Income Tax Act 1989.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial statement: brief statement of the corporation's financial condition (assets and liabilities) as of the anniversary date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No audited financial statements are required; a one-page balance-sheet summary suffices. Maintain full books and records outside the RMI. Stripe/PayPal risk review may request an operating statement evidencing SaaS revenue, payroll, and intercompany contracts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of US$200 per report; administrative dissolution by the Registrar if the report is not filed for two consecutive years; reinstatement requires payment of all arrear franchise fees plus the Registrar's reinstatement fee. Continued trading after dissolution triggers unlimited personal liability of directors for all new corporate debts under the corporate veil-piercing rule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Corporation Gross Income Tax Return (prescribed form under the Income Tax Act 1989) — paper filing with the RMI Tax and Revenue Office (Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services); e-filing is generally unavailable and submission is made directly or through the RMI registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — one return per fiscal year (calendar year or approved fiscal year).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the 15th day of the third month after the close of the fiscal year (or other date fixed by the Tax and Revenue Office); tax on RMI-source gross income is due with the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from sources within the Marshall Islands for the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the Helpdesk SaaS BC this must be zero. Merely billing an RMI resident customer through Stripe/PayPal can create RMI-source income risk if the underlying services are performed in the RMI; the exemption protects only foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt non-resident domestic corporation designation under the Income Tax Act 1989.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark the statutory exemption box and attach the non-resident status declaration and the latest annual report proof. Without the marked status, the 11% gross-income tax applies to any RMI-source revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Revenue Tax deposit (3%) applicable to holders of an RMI business license.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable. An offshore non-resident BC must not obtain an RMI business license; obtaining one would destroy the non-resident exemption and impose the 3% gross revenue tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the 11% corporate gross income tax on RMI-source gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute nil for foreign-source SaaS income. Under the RMI gross-receipts model, deductions are not allowed against gross income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late-payment penalty of 20% on the unpaid tax plus statutory monthly interest (0.5% per month); understatement/evasion penalties of up to 50%; willful tax evasion is a criminal offense punishable by fine and imprisonment. Directors who sign a false return are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax and penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (nil). The Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch-remittance tax, and no undistributed-profits tax on a Business Corporation. Dividends may be declared in any currency and remitted freely without RMI tax, exchange control, or governmental approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive income tax treaty network (only limited tax information exchange agreements and the US Compact of Free Association, which does not grant withholding relief). Treaty relief is unnecessary because the RMI statutory withholding rate on all outbound payments is 0%. A shareholder seeking home-jurisdiction foreign tax credits may obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption or Certificate of Residence from the RMI Tax and Revenue Office (submitted through the registered agent), which evidences that the BC paid no RMI income tax; the annual report's non-resident declaration is the underlying document supporting that certificate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: RMI statutory withholding tax on outbound royalties and interest: 0% (nil). Royalties for software/IP and interest on shareholder or third-party debt paid by a non-resident BC to non-residents are not subject to RMI withholding tax, and no treaty-reduction mechanism is needed. No domestic relief filing (e.g., a tax residency certificate submission) is required in the RMI. The recipient bears only home-state source taxation; a US recipient failing to self-certify on Stripe/PayPal may face US 30% FATCA backup withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No RMI statutory transfer-pricing regime and no Local File/Master File threshold exists. Defensive OECD-aligned best practice: prepare contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation where the multinational SaaS group's consolidated annual revenue exceeds USD 10,000,000 (the RMI uses the US dollar as local currency), anticipating IRC Section 482 audits in the shareholder's home jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI does not enact BVI/Cayman-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), and a non-resident BC has no statutory obligation to employ local staff or hold local premises. However, OECD/EU tax-transparency peer review, FATCA/CRS automatic exchange, and banking/payment-rail KYC (Stripe, PayPal) require genuine substance to open and maintain merchant and bank accounts. Satisfactory substance for a Helpdesk SaaS BC consists of: (i) board meetings (physical or virtual) and shareholder consents located outside the RMI; (ii) IP, master SaaS agreements, and personnel employed by the foreign parent or group; (iii) real commercial contracts with end customers; (iv) arm's-length intercompany service and license fees; and (v) records proving management and control abroad. A shell BC routing Stripe/PayPal revenue without operating substance is classified as a sham arrangement and triggers account termination and criminal AML exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — False Non-Resident Exemption Claim (Income Tax Act 1989)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Earning RMI-source gross income (e.g., employing local personnel in Majuro to deliver helpdesk support, performing SaaS contracts on-island, or holding RMI-situs intellectual property) while continuing to file the non-resident declaration and paying zero tax; alternatively, fabricating books to reclassify RMI-source income as foreign-source.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of the full 11% corporate gross income tax on RMI-source revenue, plus a 20% late-payment penalty, monthly statutory interest, and an evasion penalty of up to 50%; criminal conviction for willful tax evasion carries fines and imprisonment under the Income Tax Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign false returns or knowingly file the false non-resident declaration are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax and penalties; civil recovery may be enforced directly against personal assets; convicted directors face travel bans (preclusion from leaving the RMI), asset-freezing orders, and custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Substance (Registrar of Corporations and AML Framework)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the BC with no employees, no contracts, no operating expenditure, and no functional bank account; using it purely as a pass-through invoicing vehicle to collect Stripe/PayPal customer payments for services actually delivered by the foreign parent, without any intercompany agreement or arm's-length markup.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Stripe/PayPal account termination, rolling reserves, and merchant-of-record blacklisting; the RMI-licensed registered agent must file a suspicious transaction report and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit may issue a freezing order; the Registrar may strike off the corporation for breach of beneficial-ownership disclosure rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Sham-entity doctrines allow the corporate veil to be pierced, making the parent, UBOs, and directors liable to creditors and tax authorities out of personal assets; directors risk placement on international AML watchlists, a statutory bar from managing RMI entities, and criminal prosecution for operating a sham vehicle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / AML-CTF (RMI AML/CFT Act, FATF-Aligned)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving SaaS subscription payments derived from stolen cards or sanctioned customers; layering refunds and commission payments to third parties; commingling customer funds with personal funds in personal PayPal/Stripe accounts while using the BC to obscure the origin of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Freezing and forfeiture of assets; monetary penalties under the RMI AML/CFT framework (fines up to and exceeding US$250,000 for registered entities); criminal imprisonment for predicate money-laundering offenses; mandatory suspicious activity reporting by the payment processor to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and UBOs are personally prosecutable for money laundering; personal travel bans, extradition risk to the United States, and confiscation orders against personal property are enforceable. The low inherent AML risk of customer-support software does not immunize willful misuse of the corporate vehicle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Veil Piercing / Wrongful Trading After Dissolution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the BC after the Registrar administratively dissolved it for two consecutive years of unpaid franchise fees or unfiled annual reports; signing contracts and collecting Stripe/PayPal payments in the name of a dissolved entity; transferring assets out of the BC to defeat creditors (fraudulent conveyance).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Contracts concluded after dissolution are void and the corporation lacks capacity to sue; the Registrar may revoke the corporate name; directors become personally liable for all debts incurred after dissolution under the Business Corporations Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Unlimited personal civil liability for all post-dissolution corporate debts; criminal penalties for commercial-document misrepresentation; directors may be barred from managing any RMI entity for a statutory period; travel bans and asset seizure may be imposed pending restitution proceedings.
